summary: Project to add TRP coin currency rewards on race end scoreboard, team creation/membership limits with TRP cost, and an admin-managed seasonal/holiday system tab.

existing_features.title: Implement TRP Coins as the in-app currency name and award 900–1000 TRP Coins at the end of each completed non-practice race, shown on the Race Results scoreboard.
Add admin capabilities to grant an arbitrary amount of TRP Coins (including very large amounts) and expose this via an admin UI and/or existing admin command flow.
Replace the placeholder Teams pages with real UI backed by the backend teams APIs, including a create-team flow showing the 50,000 TRP Coins cost and enforcing the 100-member limit in the UI.

Add a new "System" tab/page in the main navigation with sections for Winter, Spring, Summer, and a "Secret Holidays" area; Secret Holidays must be admin-managed (add/remove) via backend-backed admin controls.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement TRP coin currency: earn 900–1000 TRP at end-of-race scoreboard; admins can grant themselves unlimited TRP.
Add teams feature: create a team for 50,000 TRP; limit teams to 100 members.
Add a System tab for seasons/holidays (Winter/Summer/Spring + secret holidays) that admins can manage/add.
Add backend support to credit TRP Coins to the caller’s profile balance when a non-practice race is completed, and return the awarded amount to the frontend as part of the race completion flow.
Implement Teams in the backend with: team creation costing 50,000 TRP Coins, a hard limit of 100 members per team, and membership management APIs for listing teams and viewing team details.

projectName: Add TRP Coins rewards, teams with TRP cost/member limit, and admin-managed Seasons/System tab
